subject: Signal and System
questionText:
Let x1(t) and x2(t) be two CT signals whose Fourier 
transforms are X1(ω) and X2(𝜔𝜔) respectively of x1(t) 
= e–t – 1 u(t) and x2(t) = e–t– jπt u(t) then which of the 
following relations is true? 
(a) X1(–j𝜔𝜔) = –X1(jω)  
(b) X2(–j𝜔𝜔) = –X2(jω)  
(c) X1(–j𝜔𝜔) = X1 *(jω)  
 
(d) X2(–j𝜔𝜔) = X2 *(jω)
explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-26 (Properties of CTFT).
